newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine ports strike-bound, flights little hit.
newsitem.headline: Argentine ports strike-bound, flights little hit.

text.p: Argentine ports were hard hit by the 36-hour general strike due to last until midnight local time (0300 Saturday GMT), the national ports authority and shipping agents said Friday.
But international flights from Buenos Aires's main airport were little affected.
Only terminals one and two of the port of Buenos Aires were operating. The ports of Bahia Blanca, Necochea, Rosario, Villa Constitucion, and San Antonio were not working.
But Corrientes and Ushuaia were operating as usual, according to a ports authority official.
International flights from Buenos Aires' Ezeiza airport were little hit by the strike. But the flag carrier Aerolineas Argentinas rescheduled some domestic flights out of Jorge Newbery airport.
The strike is being led by the CGT trade union confederation in protest at 17.1-percent unemployment and government drives for austerity and more flexible labor laws.
